name: VoxelBlur Depth-of-Field Volume Rendering
aliases: Depth of Field Effects for Interactive Direct Volume Rendering implementation
definition: An interactive direct volume rendering program that provides a depth-of-field effect by selectively blurring voxels depending on the distance to a predefined focus plane, simulating real-world camera lens systems.
summary: VoxelBlur is an interactive direct volume rendering method that simulates depth-of-field by selectively blurring voxels based on distance from a focus plane using custom shader-based blending.
